newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mayor of French town shot by disgruntled resident.
newsitem.headline: Mayor of French town shot by disgruntled resident.

text.p: The mayor of the southern French town of Crest was shot and wounded on Wednesday by a man who had been denied financial help by local authorities, police said.
Herve Mariton was leaving the town hall with his wife and children when he was shot in the hand and arm by a man with a 9-mm handgun. He was hospitalised.
The assailant was detained. Earlier in the day, the man had stormed into the local welfare office to request psychiatric care and fired a shot without wounding anyone.

"It's time people had some respect for local authorities," Mariton, a former member of the French parliament who also serves as vice-president of the Rhones-Alpes regional council, told reporters in hospital.
